question.text: A circular disc with a groove along its diameter is placed horizontally. A block of mass $1 \mathrm{~kg}$ is placed as shown. The coefficient of friction between the block and all surfaces of groove in contact is $\mu=2 / 5$. The disc has an acceleration of $25 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2$. Find the acceleration of the block with respect to disc.

solution.text:
Normal reaction in vertical direction $N_1=m g$
Normal reaction from side to the groove $N_2=m a \sin 37^{\circ}$
Therefore, acceleration of block with respect to discs
$$
a_r=\frac{m a \cos 37^{\circ}-\mu N_1-\mu N_2}{m}
$$
Substituting the values we get, $\quad a_r=10 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2$
